node_labels.u0: Normal progress: there is no fall currently waiting to be recovered, and the task is not yet complete. Reach the exit while holding the box; if it slips before then, pick it up again before continuing. Arriving at the exit without it does not complete the task and leaves the box still to be recovered.
node_labels.u1: The box has fallen and has not been picked up again. The immediate requirement is to recover it; picking it up away from the exit returns you to normal progress, while reaching the exit with it in hand completes the task. Reaching the exit while still empty-handed does not finish the task and leaves the box still needing to be held.
node_labels.u2: You have reached the exit without the box in hand, and no fall occurred on that arrival. Completion is not yet achieved: the box must still be picked up and held. Once it is in your hands, the task completes.
node_labels.u3: You have reached the exit with the box in hand, and any earlier fall has been answered by picking the box back up. All task requirements are satisfied, so the task is complete and nothing further remains to be done.
node_labels.u4: You have reached the exit while the box was not in your hands, with a fall leaving it to be recovered. This is not completion: the box must still be picked up and held. Once it is back in your hands, the task is complete.

card.task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

node_labels.u0: You are in normal progress: no fall is awaiting an immediate pickup, and there is no unresolved exit-without-box problem. The box may be in your hands or, after a fall, put down on the floor. If the box slips, you must be holding it again on the very next step. When you reach the exit, make sure you are carrying the box.
node_labels.u1: The box has just slipped from your hands, so the immediate-pickup requirement is now due. You must be holding the box again on the very next step; doing so restores normal progress, and doing so while stepping onto the exit also satisfies the carrying condition. If you are not holding it on that next step, the task fails permanently.
node_labels.u2: You have reached the exit without the box in hand, so the exit carrying condition is unmet and this costs you. This is not the outright pickup failure; if the box is in your hands on a later step, normal progress is restored, and a fall recorded while this carrying failure is unresolved leads to a more severe pending-pickup situation. Because the episode ends upon reaching the exit, however, this normally marks an unsuccessful exit.
node_labels.u3: This is the combined fall-and-exit-failure situation: a fall is recorded while the exit carrying condition is already unmet, and the cost is heavier. You owe an immediate pickup: be holding the box on the very next step to return to normal progress. If you are still empty-handed then, the task fails permanently.
node_labels.u4: You failed to hold the box on the step immediately after a fall, so the immediate-pickup requirement has been broken. This is an irreversible failure: successful completion is no longer possible.

card.task: Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.
